api_group.calculation_note: SK's official YUBASE site, 'Product > Performance' page (yubase.com, Wayback Machine snapshot 2019-04-22; identical text in the 2010-02-13 snapshot): 'All YUBASE (with exception of YUBASE-3 and YUBASE-L3 both of which are Group II because their Viscosity Index is below 120) are Group III category'. YUBASE 6 is listed as an SK grade on the same site's SDS page. Not stated in the archived NARMAK TRADE property sheet. Supersedes the brand-level SK Enmove page and the third-party SlideShare copy of SK Corporation's 2000 paper (slide 10), which agrees (2026-10 audit).

chemistry.calculation_note: Safety Data Sheet 'Product Name: Yubase 6', reference HIL0045, issued 2021-09-28, version 5.0, issued by Hilditch Pty Ltd (SK's Australian supplier), Section 3 p.1: 'Distillates, petroleum, hydrotreated heavy paraffinic, CAS 64742-54-7, 100 % (w/w)'. This is the supplier of record's regulatory SDS for this grade, not an SDS issued by SK Lubricants / SK Enmove; SK's own 2019 YUBASE 6 SDS is linked from yubase.com but no copy could be retrieved. Not stated in the archived NARMAK TRADE sheet DL2-11306.pdf. The earlier Scribd-hosted source is recorded in open questions (2026-10 audit).
